title: Custom Zip Geometric Pouch In Alligator

ld.name: Custom Zip Geometric Pouch In Alligator
ld.description: Pre-owned and now (re)loved, this Zip Geometric Pouch is a very special Coach custom design inspired by our commitment to rethinking and reducing our impact on the planet. Saved from the landfill, this gently-worn bag was lovingly repaired and transformed by our in-house craftspeople who added clever details to give it a second life. It’s completely one-of-a-kind, and comes with its own unique set of charms. Wear it, love it, pass it on. Reimagined by Savannah Sutton with a pastel geometric patchwork featuring a mix of luxe leathers and delicate floral blooms, this zip-top style has been expertly cleaned, conditioned and restored. Our talented craftspeople Jose Reyna, Alfred Deaza and Yngrid Pichardo Baez hand-decorated the front with an assortment of Coach remnants, spot-painted the front and binding, then added a playful repurposed charm. Our geometric pouch is a bag that celebrates our legacy and authentic New York heritage. A polygon Coach design from 1993 inspired this hexagon style. Crafted of luxurious genuine alligator leather, it has an organized interior and an exterior slip pocket for easy access to essentials.
